title: Dose optimisation
text: dmd_dose_optimise() takes clinical dose (e.g. 1000 mg) returns best combination AMPPs (branded packs) dm+d deliver . “Best” controlled objective argument, accepts one : cheapest — lowest pro-rata cost across priced combinations. min_items — fewest tablets, capsules, ampoules, discrete items. most_expensive — highest-cost combination (useful worst-case cost modelling budget-impact analysis upper bounds). Pass character vector request multiple objectives , use objective = "" shorthand three. default c("cheapest", "min_items"). Preparations segregated automatically: immediate-release tablets, modified-release tablets, oral solutions, solutions injection get row never mixed single combination. Combination products (multiple active ingredients one VMP) skipped warning dose target ambiguous — see “Combination products” dose single ingredient. Packs holding several products (titration packs, co-packs) skipped reason, warning , name gives product’s strength mass units.
